text: 此人不能告诉你什么。
source_text: 此人不能告诉你什么。

text: You see one of Shady Sands' guards.
source_text: You see one of Shady Sands' guards.

text: 你看到一个沙荫镇的卫兵。
source_text: 你看到一个沙荫镇的卫兵。

text: Hey, I think you'd better be leaving. We don't want your kind here.
source_text: Hey, I think you'd better be leaving. We don't want your kind here.

text: 嘿！我认为你最好离开这儿。我们不希望有你这样的人在这里。
source_text: 嘿！我认为你最好离开这儿。我们不希望有你这样的人在这里。

text: I can't believe that Tandi has disappeared. I hope you are going to find her. It would really hurt Aradesh if something bad happened to her.
source_text: I can't believe that Tandi has disappeared. I hope you are going to find her. It would really hurt Aradesh if something bad happened to her.

text: 难以相信，坦蒂居然失踪了。我希望你能找找她。如果有什么不好的事发生在她身上，亚拉德什会很受打击的。
source_text: 难以相信，坦蒂居然失踪了。我希望你能找找她。如果有什么不好的事发生在她身上，亚拉德什会很受打击的。

text: Thanks for returning Tandi. It's a good sign for the future, don't you think?
source_text: Thanks for returning Tandi. It's a good sign for the future, don't you think?

text: 谢谢你送回了坦蒂。这是个好兆头，对吧？
source_text: 谢谢你送回了坦蒂。这是个好兆头，对吧？

text: That's a damn shame about Tandi. I hope Aradesh will be ok.
source_text: That's a damn shame about Tandi. I hope Aradesh will be ok.

text: 那对坦蒂来说是奇耻大辱。我真希望亚拉德什不会太难过。
source_text: 那对坦蒂来说是奇耻大辱。我真希望亚拉德什不会太难过。

text: Welcome, stranger. We don't see your kind often.
source_text: Welcome, stranger. We don't see your kind often.

text: 你好，陌生人。我们可不常见到你这样的人。
source_text: 你好，陌生人。我们可不常见到你这样的人。

text: Uh, thanks. Bye.
source_text: Uh, thanks. Bye.

text: 呃，谢谢了。再见。
source_text: 呃，谢谢了。再见。

text: Why not?
source_text: Why not?

text: 为什么不？
source_text: 为什么不？

text: Hnnng!
source_text: Hnnng!

text: 哼！
source_text: 哼！

text: Not so fast! This is a small community. We don't see strangers often, and we don't really need them if you get my meaning. If you don't have a good reason to be here, you'd better just keep moving.
source_text: Not so fast! This is a small community. We don't see strangers often, and we don't really need them if you get my meaning. If you don't have a good reason to be here, you'd better just keep moving.

text: 别急！这是个小部落。我们不常见到陌生人，我们不需要陌生人你明白吗？如果你拿不出个留下来的好理由，就最好快滚。
source_text: 别急！这是个小部落。我们不常见到陌生人，我们不需要陌生人你明白吗？如果你拿不出个留下来的好理由，就最好快滚。

text: Hey, I ain't gonna hurt anybody.
source_text: Hey, I ain't gonna hurt anybody.

text: 嘿！我不会伤害任何人的。
source_text: 嘿！我不会伤害任何人的。

text: Uh.
source_text: Uh.

text: 嗯。
source_text: 嗯。

text: I wasn't saying that you was gonna. You'd just better leave us alone.
source_text: I wasn't saying that you was gonna. You'd just better leave us alone.

text: 我没说你会伤害谁。你最好快点离我们远点。
source_text: 我没说你会伤害谁。你最好快点离我们远点。

text: I'll try not to make trouble.
source_text: I'll try not to make trouble.

text: 我会尽量不捅乱子的。
source_text: 我会尽量不捅乱子的。

text: I'm sick and tired of your trash. Prepare to meet your maker.
source_text: I'm sick and tired of your trash. Prepare to meet your maker.

text: 我受够了你的废话！准备受死吧。
source_text: 我受够了你的废话！准备受死吧。

text: Look, Shady Sands don't need your kind from the Hub, or Junktown, or wherever you come from. We do pretty good by ourselves.
source_text: Look, Shady Sands don't need your kind from the Hub, or Junktown, or wherever you come from. We do pretty good by ourselves.

text: 你得明白，沙荫镇不需要像你这样来自哈勃城，迦克镇或是其他什么鬼地方的家伙。我们自己可以过得非常好！
source_text: 你得明白，沙荫镇不需要像你这样来自哈勃城，迦克镇或是其他什么鬼地方的家伙。我们自己可以过得非常好！

text: The last trader from the Hub sold us a malfunctioning irrigation pump. We've had it with your dirty deals.
source_text: The last trader from the Hub sold us a malfunctioning irrigation pump. We've had it with your dirty deals.

text: 最近有个哈勃城商人卖给了我们一个有故障的灌溉水泵。我们就是和类似你那样肮脏的人交易才得到这个破东西。
source_text: 最近有个哈勃城商人卖给了我们一个有故障的灌溉水泵。我们就是和类似你那样肮脏的人交易才得到这个破东西。

text: You got it all wrong. I'm not like that.
source_text: You got it all wrong. I'm not like that.

text: 你弄错了。我可不那么龌龊。
source_text: 你弄错了。我可不那么龌龊。

text: Yeah, right. So you say. Just don't get into any trouble, Ok?
source_text: Yeah, right. So you say. Just don't get into any trouble, Ok?

text: 好。这可是你说的。千万别出什么岔子，知道了吗？
source_text: 好。这可是你说的。千万别出什么岔子，知道了吗？

text: No problem.
source_text: No problem.

text: 没问题。
source_text: 没问题。

text: Yeah, whatever.
source_text: Yeah, whatever.

text: 好，随便吧。
source_text: 好，随便吧。

text: Well, maybe you aren't. You do seem a little different to me. I'll tell you what. You should go talk to Aradesh. He is in the center of town.
source_text: Well, maybe you aren't. You do seem a little different to me. I'll tell you what. You should go talk to Aradesh. He is in the center of town.

text: 那么，可能你不是那样。但你似乎真的跟我不太一样。我会告诉你我们的差别在哪儿。你应该去见见亚拉德什。他在镇中心。
source_text: 那么，可能你不是那样。但你似乎真的跟我不太一样。我会告诉你我们的差别在哪儿。你应该去见见亚拉德什。他在镇中心。

text: We don't want your kind here. Go back to wherever you came from.
source_text: We don't want your kind here. Go back to wherever you came from.

text: 我们不想让你这样的人呆在这里。哪儿来的就回哪儿去！
source_text: 我们不想让你这样的人呆在这里。哪儿来的就回哪儿去！

text: Hey, no need for weapons. We don't look too kindly on those around here.
source_text: Hey, no need for weapons. We don't look too kindly on those around here.

text: 嘿！别拿武器，我们当地人对外面来的人也不会太友善的。
source_text: 嘿！别拿武器，我们当地人对外面来的人也不会太友善的。

text: Hey, you didn't turn out to be such a bad person after all. Have a nice day.
source_text: Hey, you didn't turn out to be such a bad person after all. Have a nice day.

text: 嘿！事实证明你并不是个坏人。祝你过得愉快。
source_text: 嘿！事实证明你并不是个坏人。祝你过得愉快。

text: I really wish you would just leave town.
source_text: I really wish you would just leave town.

text: 我真的希望你可以离开这个小镇。
source_text: 我真的希望你可以离开这个小镇。

text: 【MORE】
source_text: 【MORE】

text: 【更多】
source_text: 【更多】
